description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of epochs and the Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning methods of the Whisper model, specifically for the "tiny" type. The x-axis represents the epoch, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6, and tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis represents the WER, also with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 70, with tick labels at every 10 units. The plot displays five lines, each representing a different fine-tuning method: tiny AdaLoRA_int4 (red circle marker, solid line), tiny AdaLoRA_int8 (red square marker, solid line), tiny int4 (blue circle marker, dashed line), tiny int8 (blue square marker, dashed line), and tiny full (green triangle marker, dotted line). The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line starts at approximately 68 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to around 38 WER at epoch 6. The tiny AdaLoRA_int8 line begins at about 59 WER at epoch 0 and drops to roughly 34 WER at epoch 6. The tiny int4 line commences at approximately 69 WER at epoch 0 and declines to around 40 WER at epoch 4, before slightly decreasing further. The tiny int8 line starts at about 57 WER at epoch 0 and decreases to roughly 37 WER at epoch 6. The tiny full line remains relatively stable, starting at approximately 31 WER at epoch 0 and ending at around 26 WER at epoch 6. All lines except tiny full exhibit a downward trend across the epochs, with varying rates of decrease.
